replacements.instruction: Experimental Design 冒頭の In this experimental design と seven pre-specified systems の重複を除き、比較目的から直接始める。
replacements.before: In this experimental design, we consider the seven pre-specified systems described in Section~\ref{sec:baselines} under the same task inputs and information policy. The comparisons address three questions: (1) whether process-level organization improves long-form document quality relative to alternative writing systems, (2) which proposed components contribute to any advantage, and (3) how the writing loop behaves in practice. We also include one post-hoc execution variant as an exploratory diagnostic.
replacements.after: We compare the writing systems under the same task inputs and information policy to address three questions: (1) whether process-level organization improves long-form document quality relative to alternative writing systems, (2) which proposed components contribute to any advantage, and (3) how the writing loop behaves in practice. We also include one post-hoc execution variant as an exploratory diagnostic.
